svg.title: GC allocation across workloads. PurrNet’s estimated GC allocation rate was 82% lower than FishNet across the active workloads. NetworkTransform + SyncVars + RPCs + spawn/despawn, 100 connections, 20 Hz.

cc:Work.dc:title: GC allocation across workloads. PurrNet’s estimated GC allocation rate was 82% lower than FishNet across the active workloads. NetworkTransform + SyncVars + RPCs + spawn/despawn, 100 connections, 20 Hz.
cc:Work.dc:description: Arithmetic mean of server gcAllocBytesPerSec. Tests: MoveY, MoveWander, SyncVars, SendRPC, ClientInput, SpawnChurn. Sessions: 100 connections, 20 Hz. 10 s windows. No idle subtraction. Binary byte units (1 KiB = 1,024 bytes). One published run. Overloaded rows describe saturated servers and are not used for comparative claims. Allocation is estimated from frame-to-frame managed-heap growth, using a running average when collection shrinks the heap.
